items.title: EIP-8037 PR：说明结算前 gas 回流和储备传递
items.note: （flcl42，非作者补充）。现行文本只提到“两次 `GAS` 读数相减会得到负数”；PR 补充：清空本交易新建的槽会把最多 97,920 gas 立即退回 `gas_left`，回滚会恢复状态 gas 记账，储备全额传给子调用，因此帧内花掉的 gas 可以在结算前回来。
items.title_en: EIP-8037 PR: document gas returning before settlement and reservoir forwarding
items.note_en: (flcl42, a non-author addition). The current text only says that "a contract measuring work as the difference between two `GAS` reads then gets a negative value". The PR adds that clearing a slot created earlier in the transaction refills up to 97,920 gas into `gas_left` immediately, that reverts restore state gas accounting, and that the reservoir passes to child frames in full, so gas spent within a frame can come back before the transaction settles.

items.title: EIP-8141：用 max_fee 约束成本
items.note: 合并（lightclient），在 frame 对象里引入 `max_fee`，取代分维度资源上限，改编自 EIP-7999。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: use max_fee to bound cost
items.note_en: Was merged (lightclient), adding `max_fee` to the frame object instead of per-dimension resource limits, adapted from EIP-7999.

items.title: EIP-8141：在 max_fee 预算下规定 GASPRICE
items.note: 合并（spencer-tb）。未用 gas 现在也能支撑小费，单价取决于 `gas_used`，`GASPRICE` 无法精确，于是返回下界 `base_fee_per_gas + max_priority_fee // max_gas`；`max_fee` 覆盖全部小费时精确，且不会高于付款方的实际单价，gas 退款合约不会多付。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: specify GASPRICE under the max_fee budget
items.note_en: Was merged (spencer-tb). Unused gas can now back the tip, so the price per gas depends on `gas_used` and `GASPRICE` cannot be exact. It returns the lower bound `base_fee_per_gas + max_priority_fee // max_gas`, which is exact whenever `max_fee` covers the full tip and never above what the payer pays per gas, so gas refund contracts cannot be overpaid.

summary_en: The postponement reached the specs and announcements: the EF and Alex Stokes posted notices for operators, EIP-7773 cleared the Hoodi activation time, and a new EIP-8037 PR writes "spent gas can come back before settlement" into its security considerations. lightclient said publicly that he does not like EIP-8037/8038, since they only let the gas limit rise without solving ever-growing state. Frame transactions now bound cost with a single `max_fee`, and `GASPRICE` returns a lower bound.
